findings.failing_input: Supabase responds with a partial degradation (e.g. rate-limit 429 with body but no `error` field).
findings.expected: pingSupabase distinguishes auth/quota failures from 'down' (the SyncIndicator amber UI is per-condition).
findings.actual: Any non-null `error.message` collapses to status='down'. Operator console can't tell 'service-role key revoked' from 'connection timeout'. Sanitized userFacingError() then further collapses these. For HEALTH endpoint specifically, more granularity is useful since SyncIndicator's whole purpose is operator triage.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a coarse classifier: if /quota|429|rate/i.test(error.message) → status='quota'; else 'down'. Extend HealthStatus type.
findings.regression_test_idea: Mock supabase select() to return { error: { message: 'rate limit exceeded' } }; assert status==='quota'.

findings.expected: The Phase 05.7 'sheets always ok' field is documented for backward-compat. A v2 deprecation timeline would be useful.
findings.actual: Field stays in the response indefinitely. Future readers may think Sheets is actually still pinged.
findings.fix_sketch: Comment is already clear. Optionally schedule deprecation via a follow-up Phase 12.x backlog item.

uncertainty_notes: Route is the most-tested API route in scope (literal-vs-config sync test). The Sheets backward-compat field is explicitly justified in the file-level comment. status=200 always is the documented soft-fail convention.
test_coverage_gaps: No test of the actual GET handler — only the revalidate literal sync. Add tests for: (a) success path returns sheets='ok'+supabase='ok', (b) Supabase ping throws → supabase='down'+errors.supabase set, (c) Cache-Control header set.
